name: SatNet LEO Group TBD?
location_str: Commercial LC-2 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
destination_explanation: A satellite this low sweeps across the sky in a few minutes, so a ground station only gets a short window to talk to it on each pass.
slot_a_text: A batch of 9 Low Earth Orbit communication satellites for the Chinese state owned SatNet constellation operated by the China Satellite Network Group. The constellation will eventually consists of 13000 satellites.
slot_b_text: Commercial LC-2 has flown 10 launches since its first in 2024, 7 of them this year. The pad had 30 days to reset after the last one.
